## Testing ground
in-raw-latex-block:

```{=latex}
\vspace{-23pt}
\hspace{0pt}
\begin{figure}
\includegraphics[width=1.00\linewidth]{test.png}
\end{figure}
```

in-latex-enclosure

$$
\vspace{-23pt}
\hspace{0pt}
\begin{figure}
\includegraphics[width=1.00\linewidth]{test.png}
\end{figure}
$$

verbatim

<

\vspace{-23pt}
\hspace{0pt}

\end{figure}
